newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah strengthens after band widening.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah strengthens after band widening.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah strengthened against the dollar after the central bank widened its intervention band to 12 percent to eight percent, dealers said.
They said the rupiah soared to a high of 2,410 from 2,436 to the dollar immediately after the announcement.
One local bank dealer said the first rate that appeared after the announcement was bid at 2,375 rupiah to the dollar but there was no offer.
He said operators increased their bids to 2,380 and later to 2,390, which saw counter offers at 2,410.
There was a deal done at 2,410 before the dollar gradually recovered to 2,420 and further to 2,430.
"People were shocked and shorted dollars after the surprise move. The first thing they did was sell dollars," the local bank dealer said.
Dealers said the market had been speculating on a band widening in the past few days but that when the central bank widened the band, it took the market by surprise.
